scoring_justification: The headline quantities are derived from self-reported DFT total energies; a genuine recompute from raw DFT outputs is impossible in the verifier sandbox. We compare recomputed formation energy/barrier/capacity to paper gold using threshold-or-better tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for Li adsorption energy, NEB barrier, Li2C2O2 formation energy per Li, and theoretical capacity
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: single Li ΔE_Li = -0.59 eV, NEB barrier = 0.14 eV, Li2C2O2 ΔE_Li = 0.06 eV, capacity = 957 mAh/g
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper text and Table 2
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; used as reference threshold for threshold-or-better scoring.

outputs.description: Adsorption energy of a single Li atom at the GmO H-site. DeltaE_Li should be negative; more negative is better. Contains supporting total energies.
Formation energy per Li and theoretical capacity of the fully lithiated Li2C2O2 structure. Lower DeltaE_Li is better; higher capacity is better.
NEB energy barrier for Li surface diffusion between adjacent H-sites. Lower barrier is better.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are compared against hidden paper-reported gold values using threshold-or-better scoring. Exact tolerances are hidden.

steps.description: Li adsorption energy at H-site (recomputed from total energies)
Li2C2O2 formation energy per Li (recomputed from total energies)
